market_name: Will 8 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability shift is corroborated by fed funds futures / SOFR strip moving dovish, and by any breaking macro headline (jobs, credit event).
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and 2Y/10Y yield moves against the prediction-market shift; confirm it is not stale/thin-liquidity noise on Polymarket.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether move persists or fades; look for FOMC-speak or data releases that could explain the leak.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether risk assets (SPY) are confirming a growth-scare narrative or diverging, which distinguishes dovish-easing from recession trade.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT return vs. entry; judge if the prediction-market signal had any lead over Treasury pricing or was already reflected.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 8 rate cuts (200bps of easing) in 2026 signals expectations of an aggressive, likely recession- or crisis-driven Fed pivot. That pushes the anticipated policy path far lower, driving front-to-long Treasury yields down and long-duration bond prices up. TLT is the most direct liquid proxy for a large repricing of the easing path.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and G10 crosses for confirmation alongside the market move.
time_plan.1h: Determine whether the narrative is 'orderly easing' (USD down) or 'crisis/flight-to-quality' (USD up).
time_plan.2h: Reassess dollar direction as rates and equities clarify the driver.
time_plan.6h: Compare UUP vs Treasuries move consistency; flag if they diverge.
time_plan.12h: Mark UUP return and assess whether FX moved with or lagged the prediction-market shift.

predictions.reasoning: An extreme-dovish repricing (8 cuts) compresses expected US rate differentials versus other economies, typically weakening the dollar. UUP is a liquid proxy. Signal is weaker than the rates link because a US recession scare can also trigger safe-haven USD buying, creating two-sided risk.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026; strike of 8 cuts implies ~200bps of easing, an extreme dovish outcome
Fed easing expectations map directly to Treasury yields, the dollar, and rate-sensitive assets
Mislabeled 'military_conflict' topic is inconsistent with the actual monetary-policy question
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is far above realistic 12h moves in TLT or UUP; neither prediction is expected to clear it
A dovish repricing could reflect either benign easing or a recession/crisis, which pull the dollar in opposite directions
Polymarket odds on far-out 2026 outcomes can be thin and noisy, weakening any leakage signal

llm_justification.summary: The market prices the probability of an extreme dovish Fed path (8 cuts / ~200bps in 2026). A sharp increase in that probability would signal expectations of aggressive easing, most cleanly implying lower Treasury yields (TLT up) and a somewhat weaker dollar (UUP down). Both mappings are directionally plausible but modest in 12h magnitude — well under the 700bps tradable bar — and the dollar link is muddied by safe-haven dynamics. Treat as a low-confidence research signal, not a trade.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this market reflects genuine shifts in Fed-easing expectations, not thin-market noise
Treasury and FX markets have not already fully priced the same information
An 8-cut scenario is associated with growth weakness / dovish policy rather than idiosyncratic mechanics
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is already public and reflected in rates, so no lead exists
A recession scare drives safe-haven USD buying, reversing the expected UUP-down call
Far-dated 2026 Polymarket pricing is illiquid and the 'move' is spurious
12h asset moves fall far short of the 700bps threshold, making both non-tradable
The signal reverses as new data contradicts the dovish repricing
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
